prompt: A large rectangle is $10 \times 8$. A $2 \times 3$ rectangle is cut out. Find the remaining area.

hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Sketch the shape and label every length. A 30-second drawing saves 5 minutes of thinking.
